headline: Donald Trump: It's always an option, I guess, but I don't think it'll be necessary
label: QUOTE
quote: It's always an option, I guess, but I don't think it'll be necessary
speaker: Donald Trump
title: U.S. President
caption:
US President Donald Trump has addressed the possibility of pardoning reinstated Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang amid intense scrutiny over national security concerns.

Speaking to the New York Post in an interview published on Tuesday, Trump made the remarks regarding potential criminal activity linked to Huang and the chipmaker, as reported by BBC. Lawmakers continue to demand answers following Huang's shock return to the company.

Could this unprecedented presidential intervention set a dangerous precedent for corporate governance and national security in the tech sector?
